items.title: Textron (TXT) Faces A 27% Fair Value Gap On Execution Concerns
items.summary: Textron (TXT) is back in focus after its second quarter update highlighted ongoing supply chain friction and aviation workforce inefficiencies that weighed on productivity and margins, even as demand held up. The recent 7 day share price return of Textron, down 6.0%, and a 90 day share price return down 16.7%, suggests sentiment has cooled as investors weigh those operational snags against steady demand. items.title: Textron (TXT) Unveils a Cargo Plane Concept That Needs No Pilot
items.summary: On September 14, Textron (NYSE:TXT) unit Textron Aviation and Merlin, an autonomous flight software company, introduced a cargo plane concept with nobody at the controls. Called the Cessna SkyCourier UX, it marries an FAA-certified twin-engine turboprop to Merlin’s autonomy software. The goal is keeping dispersed military forces supplied when normal supply routes get too risky. […]
